title: Ingredient Transparency: What You Need to Know About Your Formulations
excerpt: Formial Labs prioritizes ingredient transparency, openly disclosing all components in its personalized skincare. This empowers informed decisions, ensuring safety. Rigorous testing and clear labeling build trust, especially in India. Formial's dedication ensures safe, effective, and trustworthy personalized skincare.
editor: Editor : Dr Neha Fogla MBBS MD (Derm)
bodyHtml:
We believe that you have the right to know exactly what goes into your compounded formulation. That's why we are committed to ingredient transparency, ensuring that you have access to all the information you need to make informed decisions about your health.

What is Ingredient Transparency?

Ingredient transparency means that we openly share all the ingredients in your formulations, including both active and inactive ingredients. We also provide information about the source of our ingredients and any potential allergens.

Tried everything, yet your skin keeps going back to the same place?

At Formial Labs, our dermats don't guess. They assess your skin condition at the root and prepare a formulation built around you — not a shelf product.

Find Your Custom Formula
4.5 Trusted by 2,000 +Satisfied Customers

Why is Ingredient Transparency Important?

Ingredient transparency is important for several reasons:

  • Safety: Knowing all the ingredients in your medication can help you avoid potential allergic reactions or interactions with other medications you're taking.

  • Informed decision-making: Having access to complete ingredient information allows you to make informed decisions about your treatment plan.

  • Trust: We believe that you have the right to know what you're putting into your body, and we want to build trust by being open and honest about our ingredients.

How We Ensure Ingredient Transparency

We take several steps to ensure ingredient transparency at Formial Labs:

  • Sourcing: We source our ingredients from reputable suppliers who meet our strict quality standards and we check the authenticity of these ingredients.

  • Testing: We test all ingredients for purity and potency. We also test the finished products.

  • Labelling: We provide clear and comprehensive labeling on all formulations.

  • Communication: We are available to answer any questions you have about your formulation, including questions about ingredients.

How We Test and Validate Our Products

In addition to ingredient testing, we also test our compounded formulations to ensure their quality and safety meets international standards. We have consciously invested into the research and development process.

Our Commitment to Quality

Ingredient transparency is just one aspect of our commitment to quality at Formial Labs. We adhere to strict compounding standards and regulations to ensure that all our medications are safe and effective.

The Importance of Ingredient Transparency in India

In India, there is an increased risk of fake and counterfeit medications. This is due to a number of factors, including a large and complex pharmaceutical supply chain, regulatory issues and a high demand for affordable medications. Ingredient transparency can help to mitigate this risk by allowing patients to verify the ingredients in their medications and ensure that they are getting what they need.
